text.en: Dog owners praise trainer Darren for his intuitive understanding of canine behavior, clear explanations, and honest guidance. Clients appreciate the balance of structured hands-on coaching and online training videos, noting that owners receive substantial support to build their handling confidence and maintain consistency at home.

Reviewers emphasize that dogs enjoy training sessions and show excitement when visiting the facility. Owners of rescue dogs with severe anxiety or reactivity point out that the trainer reads canine body language accurately, tailoring exercise and play so that pets remain calm, focused, and eager to participate in learning.

Clients report significant behavioral improvements, transforming reactive dogs that lunged or pulled into calm walking companions. Reviewers highlight mastering loose-leash walking, solid marker words, and reliable focus around other dogs, describing the training courses as rewarding investments that greatly improve daily life.

q.en: What training methods does Darren use at Fetch?

a.en: Training incorporates marker words, reward-based motivation, structured loose-leash walking, and owner coaching.

q.en: Can reactive dogs be rehabilitated through the programme?

a.en: Yes, clients report notable success helping dogs that bark, lunge, or show reactivity when encountering other dogs on walks.

q.en: Does the facility offer dog boarding options?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention using the on-site dog hotel for overnight stays, noting that dogs return happy and well exercised.

q.en: Are online resources provided alongside in-person sessions?

a.en: Clients mention having access to instructional app videos and group Q&A sessions to support home practice between classes.
